[[Decade Spear "Mist Piercer"]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[spear]] obtained from [[Ancient Anniversary Weaponsmith]] in [[Embark Beach]] during the [[Anniversary Celebration]] in exchange for 5 [[Proof of Legend|Proofs of Legend]].

==Stats==
:[[Piercing damage|Piercing Dmg]]: 14-27 (Requires 9 [[Spear Mastery]])
:Deals 20% additional [[damage]] during [[Special event|Festival events]]. No effect in [[PvP]].
:Double [[adrenaline]] gain (Chance: 10%)
:[[Health]] +30
:Crafted in tribute to an enduring legend.

==Skin==
This spear shares a [[skin]] with the [[Spiraling Spear]].

==Replica==
This item cannot be replicated, as the "+20% damage during Festival Events" mod does not exist outside the unique Decade weapons.

==Notes==
[[File:Decade_Spear_Mist_Piercer_Swing.jpg|150px|right]]
[[File:Decade_Spear_Mist_Piercer_Flight.jpg|150px|right]]
*This spear leaves behind a cutting trail of particles with each [[auto attack]] when the wielder is not under the effects of a [[form]] or [[tonic]]. Its auto attack projectiles also leave a trail of particles.
*The inherent bonus damage during events is only active during certain events ([[Canthan New Year]], [[Anniversary Celebration]], [[Dragon Festival]], [[Wayfarer's Reverie]], [[Halloween]], and [[Wintersday]]).
{{anomaly|Unlike [[Decade Rod "All the World"]], [[Decade Rod "Antipode Alloy"]], [[Decade Rod "Undying Service"]], [[Decade Staff "Astral Pillar"]], [[Decade Staff "Underworld Pillar"]] and all non-Decade [[weapon]]s, this spear's appearance is not changed when the wielder is under the effects of a [[weapon spell]].}}

==Trivia==
*Given the almost drill-like twisting appearance where the blade meets the shaft, and the name Mist Piercer, this may be a reference to the [[w:Gurren Lagann|Gurren Lagann]] line "Your drill is the drill that will pierce the heavens!"
*Introduced in the [[Feedback:Game updates/20150422|April 22, 2015 update]].
